title: focuser_primaluce accepted X_CALIBRATE requests while a calibration step ran, which could leave a calibration run unstoppable by END
summary: The generated handler sets X_CALIBRATE OK when it starts, so the BUSY guard let further requests in during the SESTO SENSO 3 restart wait; queued calibrations ran in sequence, the last cleared the calibration state and END was refused, and the run drove into the mechanical end until the owner unplugged the focuser.
evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md (FND-000057); server log of the hardware session 2026-10-23

resolution.evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: requests are refused while a step runs, only END is accepted during the run, END without a run is refused; sestosenso3_calibration, sestosenso3_calibration_restart, calibration_end_without_run pass; hardware calibration with refused extra clicks.
